meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: HyperFrames CLI dev loop. Use when running npx hyperframes init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, render, publish, cloud, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, tts, or remove-background (validate/inspect/layout are deprecated aliases covered by check), or when troubleshooting the HyperFrames build/render environment. Entry point for HeyGen-hosted cloud rendering (`hyperframes cloud render / list / get / delete`) and self-managed AWS Lambda rendering (`hyperframes lambda deploy / render / progress / destroy / policies / sites`).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在本地开发、测试和部署 HyperFrames 项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 HyperFrames 做视频渲染，需要本地开发与云端部署一体化
copy.tagline_en: Develop, test, and deploy HyperFrames projects locally and to the cloud
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build HyperFrames video projects and need a unified local dev and cloud deploy workflow

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你运行 HyperFrames CLI 命令来创建、检查、预览和渲染视频项目，还能在云端或 AWS Lambda 上渲染。
howto.when: 当你提到运行 npx hyperframes 相关命令（如 init、check、render 等），或需要排查 HyperFrames 构建/渲染环境时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 npx hyperframes init 创建一个新视频项目。
say.note: Claude 会执行 init 命令并检查技能更新。

say.text: 运行 npx hyperframes check 检查当前项目。
用 npx hyperframes cloud render 在云端渲染视频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you run HyperFrames CLI commands to scaffold, lint, check, preview, and render video projects, and also handle cloud rendering on HeyGen or AWS Lambda.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention running npx hyperframes commands (e.g., init, check, render) or need to troubleshoot the HyperFrames build/render environment.

say_en.text: Run npx hyperframes init to scaffold a new video project.
say_en.note: Claude will execute init and check for skill updates.

say_en.text: Run npx hyperframes check on the current project.
say_en.note: Claude will run check to verify browser compatibility.

say_en.text: Render the video in the cloud with npx hyperframes cloud render.
say_en.note: Claude will zip, upload, and render via HeyGen.
